audience: accounting firms that use Silverfin for client bookkeeping and year-end closing

useCases.title: Read the trial balance of a client period
useCases.text: List the periods of a client company, then read the accounts and values of the latest trial balance.

useCases.title: Find the open reconciliations in a workflow
useCases.text: List the workflows of a period, then the reconciliations of a workflow with their status. Open one to read its data.

useCases.title: Read the results of a reconciliation
useCases.text: Find a reconciliation of a period, such as VAT for March, and read its computed results as named values.

useCases.title: Look up one account value before a client call
useCases.text: Find an account in the trial balance of a period and read its value. Check the account before you answer the client.

useCases.title: Review the client companies of the firm
useCases.text: Read the firm this server connects to, list its client companies and open one to see its VAT identifier and settings.
